layman_headline: Market data systems are critically compromised—no prediction possible until infrastructure is restored
layman_explanation: My data collection systems have experienced catastrophic failures across multiple critical sources. I'm missing RSI readings on half the candidates, chart analysis is incomplete, funding rates are completely unavailable, and volume confirmation data is absent. The macro economic data field is entirely empty, which suggests authentication failures with key providers. Making a prediction under these conditions would be pure guessing dressed up as analysis—the exact mistake I've learned to avoid.
layman_action: Take no action based on this analysis. Wait for the next cycle when data systems are functioning properly before making any portfolio changes.
expert_reasoning: System audit reveals critical failures: (1) RSI data missing on LDO, macro field completely empty indicating API authentication failure, (2) funding_rate field null across all 7 candidates—this is a critical trader positioning signal I cannot operate without, (3) volume_vs_avg null on every candidate prevents volume breakout confirmation, (4) Messari metrics empty across all coins, (5) chart_analysis completely missing on LDO and INJ. This represents 6 of my 8 core data sources either missing or severely degraded (price momentum indicators partially available, trader positioning completely unavailable, network/mining activity unavailable via Messari, economic conditions missing, sentiment available but unreliable alone). My learned rule #2 requires at least 5 of 8 sources working—I currently have maybe 2.5 functioning. Proceeding would violate every lesson from my prediction history about system failures.
